command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/andreas/self-integration
expected_before=5b06f6c40eefb9b2bb058c8117f8705cdff50a6a
expected_target=2f9fa1004ab140eb312302f799bf2e6165c4aff6
actual_before=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
[[ "$actual_before" == "$expected_before" ]] || { echo "ABORT head drift before: $actual_before" >&2; exit 40; }
[[ -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1)" ]] || { echo 'ABORT working tree dirty' >&2; git status --porcelain=v1 >&2; exit 41; }
before_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
before_epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
before_state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
[[ "$before_state" == active && "$before_pid" != 0 && -n "$before_epoch" ]] || { echo 'ABORT VM subject not active/bound' >&2; exit 42; }
printf 'PRE head=%s pid=%s epoch=%s\n' "$actual_before" "$before_pid" "$before_epoch"
git fetch --quiet origin main
remote=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
[[ "$remote" == "$expected_target" ]] || { echo "ABORT origin/main moved: $remote" >&2; exit 43; }
git merge --ff-only "$expected_target"
[[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$expected_target" ]] || { echo 'ABORT ff target mismatch' >&2; exit 44; }
bash werkzeug/semantic-state-schutz-installieren.sh
after_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
after_epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
after_state=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)
[[ "$after_state" == active && "$after_pid" == "$before_pid" && "$after_epoch" == "$before_epoch" ]] || { echo "ABORT runtime drift after install: state=$after_state pid=$after_pid epoch=$after_epoch" >&2; exit 45; }
printf 'POST head=%s state=%s pid=%s epoch=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$after_state" "$after_pid" "$after_epoch"
printf 'NO_VM_STOP=1\nNO_VM_RESTART=1\nNO_MIGRATION=1\n'
